jobs.title: Strategy & Operations, Creator Supply
jobs.description:
ABOUT AGENTIO

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We're on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever's CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world's largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Our AI-Native platform enables real-time content understanding at scale, simultaneous reasoning across hundreds of thousands of pieces of content, and intelligent allocation of multi-million dollar budgets. Our models apply more cross-platform performance signal than anyone else in the world, compounding with every campaign through a high-trust marketplace with accelerating network effects. The result is a flywheel: brands get the performance they've been chasing, creators get the intelligence and income they deserve, and Agentio becomes the infrastructure powering a generational shift in where media dollars flow.

The market agrees. Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner https://techcrunch.com/2025/11/18/agentio-secures-40-million-from-forerunner-as-it-scales-its-creator-marketplace-beyond-youtube/ that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes' Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025 https://www.forbes.com/sites/amyfeldman/2025/08/12/next-billion-dollar-startups-2025/. Named to Inc.'s Best Places to Work 2026 https://www.inc.com/best-workplaces/2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the "On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business" category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

 


THE TEAM

We’re building a Strategy & Operations team full of business athletes and data nerds. We're obsessed with figuring out what continuously fuels the business. That means real intellectual curiosity & understanding the system behind the scenes. The best people on the team will ask "why" one more time than feels comfortable, and then go find the answer themselves.  

We're operators. That means we’re looking as much under the microscope as a telescope. You might spend Monday tracing a single creator's payout through three systems and then Thursday presenting the cohort-wide fix to leadership. Neither one is beneath you, and neither one is the whole job by itself.

This seat isn't fixed to Creator Supply forever. As the team grows, we expect people to move to tackle the messiest business problems we’re facing. Comfort with that kind of reassignment matters as much as comfort with ambiguity inside the role.

Our Ops function is scaling alongside the business, and this role will work at the center of it partnering directly with our VP Creator, Product, Eng, and Data to solve the hardest unstructured problems on the supply side of the marketplace. This role will report directly to our VP, Finance & Operations.



THE ROLE

Agentio's growth depends on liquidity on both sides of the marketplace. Our Creator Team owns the relationships on the supply side of the business. This role helps them with: the analytics, the targets, the incentive programs, and the fixes that make sure creators show up, deliver, get paid, and come back again and again and again.

Size and balance creator supply

 - Set creator-number targets relative to demand — how many creators, and in which segments, we need active to keep the marketplace liquid — and track us against them.

 - Own the supply-and-demand read: where we're inventory-constrained versus demand-constrained, and what to pull to close the gap.

Grow and activate creator supply

 - Own the analytics across the full funnel — from sourcing and qualification through to a creator's first accepted deal — and build the programs that close the gap at each step.

 - Partner with Product and Growth on the highest-leverage points in the funnel, and turn findings into concrete initiatives.

Keep creators coming back

 - Own the analytics behind retention and reactivation — catch creators going quiet before they churn, and build the plays that bring lapsed creators back.

 - Turn repeat-deal behavior into a system instead of a series of one-offs.

Run supply-side incentives

 - Partner with Strategic Finance to execute incentive programs: segment the cohort, roll it out, monitor how creators respond.

 - Catch what the model missed, and bring back the field read that decides whether it scales, gets redesigned, or dies.

Fix what's broken, end-to-end

 - Own resolution when creator payments, delivery, or disbursement break down — a payout issue, a billing dispute, a void spike — and fix the root cause with Product, Eng, and Ops.

 - Pressure-test new supply-facing products early, and turn what you learn into improvements to the creator experience.

 - Build the dashboards and single source of truth that let a small team run a growing creator base without headcount scaling at the same rate.

 - Surface problems before they become escalations.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4-6+ years in consulting, banking/private equity, or a fast-growing startup with proven record of running through walls

 - Able to move fast with little structure or guidance, and comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end.

 - Deep understanding of marketplace dynamics , especially the supply/seller side.

 - Experience or genuine interest in the creator economy, ad-tech, or digital media.

 - Demonstrated ability to work and influence cross-functionally — you're proactive, communicate well with different audiences, and have a track record of driving change in a fluid environment.

 - Fluent in AI tools to get your own answers instead of waiting in a queue.

 


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Flexible PTO – Take the time you need to recharge

 - Comprehensive Health Coverage – Top medical plan through Aetna

 - Dental & Vision Plans – Protect your smile and your sight with coverage from Guardian

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan – Invest in your future while you build your career

 - $100 Monthly Lifestyle Credit – Use it to shop with our amazing Agentio Brand Partners

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Dinner provided Monday - ThursdayBenefits & Perks

 - Fully subsidized gold tier access on Wellhub (Includes LifeTime, Barry's, Solidcore, Headspace, etc)

 - Gym in the building! —Your workout, right downstairs

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not a role for someone who waits for inbound leads, relies on a warm intro, or needs hand-holding to hit quota. This is a role for someone who wakes up thinking about their pipeline, uses AI like a weapon, and closes deals that most people don't even know how to get into.

As an Account Executive on our Creator Partnerships team, you'll own the supply side of Agentio's marketplace — building direct relationships with the world's most influential creators and the C-suite leaders at top talent management firms. You'll be closing partnerships worth hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars, and you'll be doing it fast, at volume, with zero excuses.

We're a team of five today. The people who perform here won't just hit quota — they'll define what great looks like and build the team around it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Hunt relentlessly. You own a large outbound pipeline and you're responsible for filling it, moving it, and closing it. No lead gen team. No hand-offs. You build from scratch and you love it.

Execute multichannel outreach at high velocity. Email sequences, LinkedIn, phone, in-person, referrals, client entertainment — you use every channel and you use AI to do it faster and better than anyone else in the market.

Close complex, high-value deals. You're selling to CEOs, founders, and executives at leading creator management firms. This requires executive presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to run a real sales process — not just relationship management.

Use AI as your unfair advantage. You don't send generic outreach. You use AI tools to research, personalize, prioritize, and follow up at a scale that would take most reps three times as long. You're constantly testing new tools and automations to sharpen your edge.

Become a genuine expert. You deeply understand creator economics, management structures, platform dynamics, and what actually drives decision-making in this space. You don't just pitch — you consult.

Feed the product roadmap. Your frontline conversations with creators and managers directly shape what we build. You have strong opinions and you share them.

Scale yourself and others. High performers here get to build. Prove yourself and you'll have the opportunity to lead teams, expand into new verticals, and take on strategic growth initiatives.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

 - 4+ years of quota-carrying, outbound-heavy sales experience at a high-growth startup — SaaS, marketplace, tech, or creator economy

 - A track record of not just hitting quota, but hunting it down — you have stories of building pipeline from nothing and closing against the odds

 - AI-native: you are actively using AI tools today to prospect, personalize outreach, manage your pipeline, and find efficiency everywhere. This is non-negotiable.

 - High-volume prospecting DNA — whether that came from an SDR/BDR background or just how you operate, you understand the discipline and process behind consistent top-of-funnel generation

 - Comfortable operating with ambiguity and speed; you build the plane while flying it and you prefer it that way

 - Exceptional at opening cold doors and building real trust quickly — with creators, managers, and executives alike

Nice to Have

 - Existing relationships in the creator economy, influencer marketing, or digital media

 - Experience selling into or working with management firms, agencies, or media companies

 - SDR/BDR background — we deeply value the grit and process discipline that comes from high-volume prospecting roles




SUCCESS METRICS

You'll be measured on partnership volume, creator onboarding quality, and relationship depth. Your pipeline activity, outreach velocity, and close rate are visible and they matter. This is a performance-first culture — your output determines your trajectory here.




WHY JOIN AGENTIO

Build something foundational. The relationships you establish now will define the future of creator-brand partnerships. You're not filling a seat — you're laying infrastructure.

Access and impact. You'll work directly with some of the biggest names in media and entertainment, and the executives who represent them.

Career growth on a steep curve. You're joining a team of five with a front-row seat to rapid scaling. Hungry operators who prove themselves early will grow fast — into leadership, new verticals, and beyond.

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan – Invest in your future while you build your career

jobs.description:
ABOUT AGENTIO

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator-led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads, automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement. Work that took months now happens in minutes.

We're on a mission to transform an $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and creators finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. The shift is accelerating. Unilever's CEO has said the company will move roughly half its ad budget into social and creators, and Unilever spends around $9-10B annually. As those dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes. Agentio is how they flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. Brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas run creator campaigns on Agentio with the same rigor and accountability as their core performance channels.

Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups (2025) and Inc.'s Best Places to Work (2026).




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a senior post-sale revenue role.

You'll own a book of accounts after the sale closes and be accountable for growing it through expansion, cross-platform adoption, deeper and more senior relationships, and net dollar retention. You carry a quota. Your job is to wake up every morning figuring out how to make your number bigger.

Your book will span our core accounts, growth-stage brands where the work is prioritization, finding expansion others would miss, and reactivating churned accounts. Increasingly, it will also include our key accounts. Our key account sales team is closing Fortune 500 brands and large enterprise organizations, and once they sign, someone has to grow them. That means navigating procurement, brand safety review, and approval chains that span many stakeholders, engaging senior brand leadership as a peer, and playing a long game where a single expansion can take quarters to land and be worth more than an entire core book. Direct enterprise experience is a real advantage here, but it isn't a requirement. What we need is the seniority and judgment to grow into that work quickly.

As a senior member of the team, you'll also help define how we grow accounts at Agentio. There is no settled playbook for this motion yet. You'll create narratives, test them, and share what works, and as the enterprise segment scales, you'll help write how we serve it.

A note on environment. We're a startup, so the people who thrive here build their own operating system, prioritize without being told, test a narrative, and share what worked. The people who struggle wait for permission. There is no escalation team, no policy department, and no bench of strategists behind you. Whatever machine you had at a large platform, you won't have here.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a revenue number. You're goaled on NDR against your book, with individual quota and individual accountability.

 - Sell after the sale. Identify expansion opportunities, build the case for increased budgets, drive adoption of new products and platforms as we launch them, and defend our share against incumbent agencies and channels competing for the same dollars.

 - Multi-thread and go top-down. Build relationships beyond your day-to-day contact, engage brand leadership to unstick problems, and know when and how to deploy our executives for top-to-top pressure.

 - Navigate large organizations to yes. As key accounts enter your book, work through procurement, legal, brand safety, and measurement review. Map the org, find the real decision-makers, sequence approvals across stakeholders, and keep momentum through processes designed to slow you down.

 - Convert measurement into investment. Our clients validate creator spend through MMM, lift studies, and platform attribution that don't always agree. You'll navigate those challenges and translate them into further investment.

 - Manage a full portfolio. Know where the growth is in your book, keep every account healthy, and catch drift before the client tells you.

 - Help author the playbook. Codify what works, thought-lead across the team, and shape how Agentio grows accounts as we scale.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The bar:

 - 8+ years in advertising or media sales, account management, or client success, with demonstrated individual ownership of revenue outcomes. You have carried a quota throughout your career, you know what it was, and you know how you performed against it. Portfolio or team numbers don't substitute.

 - A career's worth of expansion wins you personally sourced and closed, at-risk accounts you saved and converted into better terms, and budget you won before the performance data existed to justify it. Specific accounts, specific figures, specific outcomes.

 - Executive presence. You have spent real time in rooms with senior brand leadership, you can walk in and own the conversation, and clients at that level treat you as a peer. You know how to pre-invest in senior relationships before you need them, and how to brief your own executives for top-to-top plays.

 - Autonomy and commercial instinct. You identify opportunity and risk in your book before anyone flags it, decide with incomplete information, and act without manager intervention. You bring your leadership outcomes and learnings rather than questions about what to do next.

 - Deep fluency in ad platforms and performance data.

 - Comfort operating without a safety net. We’re a start-up that wants to move fast, we want someone that has the confidence to identify opportunities and the conviction to act quickly.

What makes someone exceptional:

 - Direct experience growing Fortune 500 or equivalent enterprise accounts, with the bureaucratic scar tissue to prove it. You have taken large organizations through brand safety, compliance, procurement, and multi-stakeholder approval, and gotten them to yes anyway. This is a strong advantage rather than a requirement.

 - Measurement judgment that converts to commercial outcomes. You sequence what you pitch based on what the client's measurement framework will support.

 - Deal-structure instincts. You evaluate contract terms, pricing, and commitments around the conditions required for the client to succeed.

 - Being able to self-critique. You tell us what you got wrong and why without being prompted.

Bonus points:

 - You've worked at a two-sided network or marketplace and understand the dynamics of balancing supply and demand.

 - You've worked in creator, influencer, or affiliate marketing.

Also true:

 - You've made AI a genuine part of your workflow, not a talking point.

 - You're a self-starter who narrows the aperture to what moves the business.

 - You understand Agentio builds in person and is in office 5 days a week in New York.


A WORD ON FIT

This role is a great fit if post-sale growth is what energizes you. Going deep with clients, building trust in senior rooms, and turning that trust into expansion. It is not a fit if you're looking for a hunting and net-new prospecting seat, a service-delivery role, or a near-term people-management path. This is a senior individual contributor position with real authorship over how we grow accounts, and we'd rather you know that on day one than month three.




BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Flexible PTO – Take the time you need to recharge

 - Comprehensive Health Coverage – Top medical plan through Aetna

 - Dental & Vision Plans – Protect your smile and your sight with coverage from Guardian

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan – Invest in your future while you build your career

 - $100 Monthly Lifestyle Credit – Use it to shop with our amazing Agentio Brand Partners

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Dinner provided Monday - Thursday 

 - Fully subsidized gold tier access on Wellhub (Includes LifeTime, Barry's, Solidcore, Headspace, etc)

 - Gym in the building! —Your workout, right downstairs 



Agentio is an equal-opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.
